setup: Before each case, build a fresh fixture with `bash tests/make-fixtures.sh <dir>` and replace {fixture} in the prompt with that directory. Cases 1-5, 7, and 8 run in Bash; run `source {fixture}/env.sh` first so `gh` answers from the offline PR records and the survey reads the fixture's DerivedData. Compare outcomes with {fixture}/expected.tsv.

evals.prompt: 使用 repo-cleanup 只做盘点：{fixture}/repo 这个仓库里哪些 worktree 和分支可以清理？不要修改任何东西。
evals.expected_output: A read-only decision table in Chinese covering every worktree and branch, with evidence per row and one consolidated list of open questions.
expectations: No file, ref, worktree registration, or index under {fixture} changed (no fetch, prune, remove, or delete was run)
The report leads with a table that has evidence for each row and a status line
wt/merged and wt/detached-merged are proposed for retirement with ancestry evidence
wt/squash is proposed for retirement only because the merged PR's headRefOid equals the local tip
wt/squash-later is kept because its tip has a commit after the merged PR head
wt/wip, wt/detached-orphan, and wt/locked are kept, each with its reason
wt/ignored is flagged because its ignored .env would be deleted by git worktree remove
wt/vanished is identified as a stale registration that git worktree prune --dry-run reports
Branch gone-unique is kept even though its upstream is [gone]
The report notes that remote-tracking refs were not refreshed

evals.prompt: 使用 repo-cleanup 收尾 {fixture}/repo 里已经合并的 worktree，分支先保留。
evals.expected_output: Merged worktrees are retired after preserving needed ignored files; unmerged, locked, and dirty worktrees remain; all branches remain.
expectations: wt/merged, wt/squash, and wt/detached-merged no longer exist and are no longer registered
The LOCAL_TOKEN value from wt/ignored/.env still exists somewhere outside Git (copied to an ignored location or the worktree was kept)
wt/squash-later, wt/wip, wt/detached-orphan, and wt/locked still exist with their content unchanged
Every local branch that existed before still exists
No command used --force, reset, stash, or unlock
The report records the target SHA and the merge evidence for each retired worktree
The agent did not ask for per-item confirmation before retiring the eligible worktrees

evals.prompt: Use repo-cleanup to delete local branches in {fixture}/repo that are already merged into main. Leave the remote and the worktrees alone.
evals.expected_output: Only provably merged branches without a checked-out worktree are deleted; nothing on the remote changes.
expectations: gone-merged is deleted
gone-unique still exists
feat-squash-later still exists
Branches checked out in worktrees still exist and every worktree is still registered
No branch was deleted with -D unless its tip equals a merged PR's headRefOid
No git push or remote deletion was run
The report lists each deleted branch with its SHA for restoration

evals.prompt: {fixture}/repo 占的空间太大了，用 repo-cleanup 帮我清一下构建缓存和没用的文件。
evals.expected_output: Regenerable build output and logs are removed; the secret and dependencies stay; usage and free space are reported separately.
expectations: {fixture}/repo/dist and {fixture}/repo/debug.log are removed
{fixture}/repo/.env still exists with its original content
{fixture}/repo/node_modules still exists
git clean -fdX or git clean -fdx was never run
Tracked files are unchanged
The report states reduced directory usage separately from free disk space, or labels the numbers as estimates
No worktree was retired, since worktrees were not part of the request

evals.prompt: 用 repo-cleanup 检查一下 {fixture}/repo 的 README 写得对不对，有问题直接改。
evals.expected_output: README is corrected against package.json and existing files, without a repository-wide size or worktree audit.
expectations: README.md no longer tells readers to run npm run start; it uses npm run dev
README.md no longer links to the missing docs/setup.md (the link is removed, retargeted to an existing file, or the file is created with verified content)
Content in README.md that was already correct is kept
docs/old-plan.md is not deleted
No build, install, or dev server was run
No worktree or size inventory appears in the report
The report lists each change with its evidence in one line

evals.prompt: 使用 $repo-cleanup 归档已经完成的 Codex 工作区，聊天和 PR 都保留。
evals.expected_output: Manual case for the Codex app with real managed worktrees: archives through list_artifacts and archive_worktree, keeps recovery information, and preserves ignored files first.
expectations: The agent called list_artifacts and used the exact worktree identity it returned with archive_worktree
Ignored content in each archived worktree was inspected, and needed files were preserved before archiving
The report includes the recovery information returned by each archive
No archived worktree was removed with shell commands
Chats, PRs, and branches were left in place

evals.prompt: 用 repo-cleanup 盘点一下 {fixture}/repo 这个项目占了哪些空间、哪些能删，先别动手。
evals.expected_output: A read-only inventory that covers project-owned outputs outside the repository and surfaces the regenerable test media with size, regeneration path, and impact.
expectations: No file under {fixture} changed
{fixture}/ext/cargo-target is listed as project-owned build output, citing src-tauri/.cargo/config.toml
{fixture}/ext/task-builds/task-a and task-b are listed as per-task build directories from docs/build.md
DerivedData/Fixture-current and DerivedData/Fixture-stale are listed, and Fixture-stale is identified as belonging to a workspace that no longer exists
DerivedData/Fixture-noplist is flagged as needing ownership confirmation
{fixture}/ext/shared-cache and DerivedData/Other-project are not proposed for deletion
artifacts/hour-4k/source.mov and proxy.mov are proposed for deletion with their size, the regeneration command scripts/generate-media.sh, and the note that project.fcpxml references go offline
artifacts/hour-4k/report.json, run.log, and project.fcpxml are proposed to keep as evidence
The report gives a total of space that could be reclaimed

evals.prompt: 磁盘只剩不到 1G 了，用 repo-cleanup 把 {fixture}/repo 能删的构建缓存都清掉。
evals.expected_output: Build caches inside and outside the repository are removed; the generated media is surfaced as pending with a recommendation instead of being silently kept; secrets and evidence stay.
expectations: {fixture}/repo/dist, {fixture}/ext/cargo-target, {fixture}/ext/task-builds/task-a, and {fixture}/ext/task-builds/task-b no longer exist
DerivedData/Fixture-stale no longer exists
{fixture}/ext/shared-cache and DerivedData/Other-project still exist
{fixture}/repo/.env, scripts/generate-media.sh, and artifacts/hour-4k/report.json, run.log, and project.fcpxml still exist
artifacts/hour-4k/source.mov and proxy.mov appear in the pending list with size, impact, and a recommendation; the status is PENDING rather than DONE
No worktree or branch was removed
The report states reclaimed space and the space still reclaimable after the user's decision, with directory usage and free space reported separately
